nom: Good Molecules Bakuchiol Oil Blend for Oily Skin

avis.texte: OG Josie Maran argan oil used to smell like a donkey and it was MAGIC. By comparison, this stuff is only naturally nutty. It's softening the fine lines around my eyes and improving overall skin texture without irritating my super sensitive skin.
I really enjoy this oil, I use it every night after I tone and my skin the next morning is glowing & very moisturized. Also, my skin is oil prone and this does not exacerbate my oily pores.
So great for making skin smooth and clear. My pores looked smooth within 2 uses. My oily, sensitive skin LOVES it! I will keep purchasing each time I run out!

avis.titre: If you have a sensitive nose, avoid this
avis.texte: I just tried this tonight. Did the routine. Cleanse. Tone. OIL. Moisturize. It notes to let it soak in before proceeding with your moisturizer. I tried. After 20 minutes of gagging and waiting for it to sink in, i gave up and did my moisturizer. Absolutely will never use this again.

As stated it's intended to improve fine lines and firmness without compromising us oily folks. I can say it DID do its job and lasted me about 3 1/2 months. My skin is oily, sensitive, and not acne prone--nothing too special. Used for my pm routine. Would buy again.
I usually love Good Molecules products, but this oil is old. I cook and know what oil that has gone bad smells like. Maybe it wasn't sealed correctly.

avis.titre: I would not buy this product again
avis.texte: I was informed by store employee this product would be good for my combination skin and would not leave my skin oily. This product had zero absorption and just laid on top of skin. My face was completely oily.
This oil is awesome! I use it as a nighttime serum to allow it to penetrate deeply into my skin as I sleep! My face is soft and smooth when I awake in the morning!

Based on the comments below, there's not a lot more to add. I also have oily skin. Just like the other say the best time to use this is at night and not during the day. I love the way it makes my skin feel and look the smell isn't that great but I love the results.
I really like this product. I use it in the evening as my last step to my skincare routine

avis.titre: Its pretty good. It has a
avis.texte: Its pretty good. It has a bir of an interesting smell but its not bad or good. But it really had helped with my wrinkles and overall just brightening my skin
I like the product, but have to use it sparingly. It seems to work well, but the scent is not particularly pleasing and lingers.
It leaves my skin soft and hydrated. It works great for the combination skin with rosacea

I have combo/sensitive skin and my skin LOVES this product! I've been using this little bottle consistently for several months now. A little goes a long way! Plus, keeping the size small helps not be so wasteful and the product stays fresh. It has a bit of an earthy smell which I don't mind. It's very light weight for a facial oil! I use it at night and it makes my face feel soft and look healthy. Give it a try!
I love this oil it helped my skin I don't see my pores on my face around my cheeks and on my nose my skin feels soft and smooth it looks tighter also I will be ordering more 😊

I bought this today thinking it would help my skin because I have oily skin and am trying to fix it. I used it and noticed my face start peeling and that was even after I exfoliating it. Very disappointed with this product.

avis.titre: So far, the oil is nice.
avis.texte: So far, the oil is nice. But it seems like it makes my forehead feel more oily than before. Just started using it, so maybe it may change.

I have oily skin, have had it since a teen and now 44. I cannot believe the wonders this oil has worked! I notice a huge improvement, more so in the last few months! No more oily skin and I don't need to use this every night, maybe 3 times a week!

I tried this because I am VERY sensitive to retinol and I have VERY oily skin. Overall, I like it - with a few caveats. I only use it at night (and not always every night): it's too oily for you me to wear during the day under makeup AND I am still a bit sensitive, so I'm cautious. I use it as suggested as the LAST step in my nighttime routine, so over moisturizer. In my case, although I'm 54, I still don't have many fine lines or wrinkles but it still appears to diminish the look of my laugh lines and under eye creases. All that said, I'm giving this a 3 because of the SMELL - it's like old French fry grease. Although I'm pleased that it clearly has no fragrance added, the fragrance it has is a little GROSS!

After talking to the employee at ULTA, I decided to give this a shot. Best decision ever! This is the last step of my nighttime routine. It takes about 4 drops for my whole face and neck. I can tell a noticeable difference in the health and tightness of my skin, and my face isn't nearly as oily! Please understand you should use this at night only- it takes time for it to soak in.

avis.titre: i love this product so mu
avis.texte: i love this product so much. it changed the game for my skin. especially the fact that it has no preservatives or stabilizers or whatever to break me out! i have very sensitive skin and the fact that this contains only plant-derived active ingredients and no chemicals is incredibly helpful. good molecules, please do not change this formula. ever. <3 i do wish it came in a bigger size though…….

avis.titre: Love it but stained my clothes?
avis.texte: my acne prone sensitive skin really loves this but I'm pretty sure it stained my clothes, anyone else???

First day was great my skin looked hydrated and not super oily. the next day my face kept getting itchy and started to break out. The next day I started to develop swollen acne like bumps on my face. I stopped using this and my skin stated to clear up again but started to to get dry in my non oily areas. I tried it again with the same results.

This is amazing! So lightweight and my skin doesn't even feel like it has an actual oil on it! I try to steer clear of oils, but I love Good Molecules and when I saw this and the price I had to try it! Definitely recommend!
Really great !!! Really soaks in my oily skin and doesn't feel greasy on my skin !!!! Will repurchase !!! So happy I found it !!!!
This is my 3rd time ordering this. It's made my skin happy. My skin appears more supple. I love it

avis.titre: I use this twice a day as
avis.texte: I use this twice a day as part of my routine. This reduces my severe oiliness by at least 80% through out the day and night. It's amazing!

I use this product a few times a week and it has made a huge difference esp with the oil that forms in the t zone and nose! Thanks for making such great products! I love how you use science to create these serums and moisturizers…can't wait to buy and try all of your products! I love each and every product you put out!
Over all this has been good for acne rosacea skin. I had overdone it with the actives and was looking for sometimes milder and this fit the bill.

avis.titre: Best Oil for Acne Prone Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: I use this as the last step in my routine every night with my gua sha. I wake up with glowing clear skin. I can't recommend this enough if you have sensitive acne prone skin. Please don't use retinol just use this as it is so gentle and just as effective. The first night I did experience a slight purging but it went away pretty fast afterwards. This is an essential product imo as it has the bakuchiol but also rosehip oil which is high in linoleic acid which naturally controls and balances sebum production in your skin while brightening dark spots and baobab which helps to target inflammation and control breakouts as well. I see a lot of hype around oil for acne prone skin that have too many ingredients and are triple the price of this oil to be any more effective. If you have dry skin I recommend using the Good Molecules hyaluronic essence toner after wash and before moisturizer or the Good Molecules Niacinimide toner if you have normal/combination/oily skin instead. I use both depending on my skin morning and night in addition to this oil and I can't recommend enough I am actually obsessed. I am a good molecules stan as someone who is over the scam of overpriced skincare products that are full of scam ingredients. Nothing has helped my painful cystic hormonal acne and damaged skin barrier more than their products.
I am 44 with oily skin. I alternate between this and the good molecules retinol. One night Bakuchiol, next night retinol. I'm on my 3rd bottle of each and it has been working great for me.

avis.titre: I love this oil. It makes
avis.texte: I love this oil. It makes my face so soft. I also use it on other parts of my body.

This stuff is wonderful if you have sensitive combination skin like mine. It's moisturizing, brightening, and smells nice but not perfume-y. It also doesn't take much; 3 drops is enough for my whole face. After using this, my skin is soft and glowy even during the change of seasons in Minnesota!
Awesome! Have been using for a year. Recently a friend asked why I don't have wrinkles on my fore head. Excellent value at this price!

avis.titre: Way too oily for oily skin!
avis.texte: Skin does not absorb this serum. Sits on top. Very oily. Supposed to be specifically for oily skin. No.

Thank goodness I found this. This has really come through with these dry patches I am dealing with and you don't need a lot. A few drops and press it into your face. You are good to go! Also you don't need to use it often either.
Has changed the tightness and texture of my skin only reason not giving 5 stars is a lil sticky when i 1st apply it but goes away pretty quickly
I added it to my nighttime skin routine and it made my skin 100% less oily during the day. And I noticed a difference within days!
I love this!!!I have oily skin and adding this to my nighttime routine has made my t zone much less shiny through out the day. It's replaced retinol as its equally effective.

avis.titre: Great Absorption… my skin drinks this stuff
avis.texte: Love topping my skincare with this at night or if I'm working from home. Really absorbs well and adds moisture to my dry under eyes . Name is definitely misleading tho. It seems like it's mostly rose hip and baobab oils w/ a touch of bakuchiol oil (1% according to their own ingredients list), so weird to have that as 1st word in name. But still a great product.

At first I felt like this was too oily for my skin, but I tried using less and rubbing it in my hands before applying and I love it! My skin looks so good now. It is very hydrating and leaves my skin with a beautiful glow(I also use a moisturizer and sunscreen after). My fine lines are diminished and I love the simple safe ingredients, that it is cruelty free and its great price! I will be continuing use and recommending to my friends.

Honestly I was not sure how much I would love this product , but I do! It really is one of my new favorite additions to my skin care routine and really makes my face feel soft and hydrated without feeling extremely oily.

Unfortunately this product didnt work for me I think it was the baoba oil since its known to clog pores. Even if there was a purging phase i couldnt last through it because it broke me out in huge red cystic acne. I wanted to try tbis because of the bakuchoil. I know alot of people who use this who cant use retinol and have seen amazing results. Ill try a different product This did not work for me but it might work for you
This product is awesome, I don't know? But it's works for me, just at the 3 days i star using I felling my face soft and Fluffy 🙂

As an EXTREMELY oily girl, I never thought i would find a facial oil that works for me. (I stress OILY - my eyes can remove waterproof mascara on their own, the struggle has been real.) Despite all my naturally occurring oil, my skin can develop dry patches in the winter. I decided to give this a try and was ASTONISHED! It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin, and somehow did not make my oily skin worse! I use one drop on my face and one drop on my neck every night, but have used in the morning as well after particularly cold days. Im unsure yet how my skin will react in the summer, but for now this has become a winter staple.

avis.titre: Great for my mature oily skin
avis.texte: I have been using the oul for a week. I noticed a difference in my skin the first day but decided to give it a week. I add it to my night time routine and my skin is ao soft in the morning. I have a glow, not oil, but glow in the morning that last most the day. I have oily skin but it hasnt caused excessive moisture. I would recommend
Love this oil, it keeps my face hydrated and glowy. A little goes a long way, just warm in hands & press on face. You don't even need moisturizer after.

I have so many issues with retinol; it doesn't matter which one I buy or how much I try to buffer it, my skin becomes inflamed and angry. When I found this bakuchiol, I was so excited because I finally found a product that works for me! I can use this 2-3 times a week and I feel it has helped with my fine lines over time! I hope this product stays around for a long long time because it is truly one of my holy grails!
From a skin professional, this is great. Especially with my oily to dry combination skin type. I love this oil.
I had high hope for this Bakuchiol oil but it did nothing to my face. I used it every day in the evening and saw no results at all but a greasy face after applying it.

I'm not one to use oil on my face because I was scared of breakouts but this oil is different. I'm 38 and started noticing some lines and a bit of dryness so I added this oil to my regimen. It is non-greasy, it absolves easily, it gives a subtle glow and kinda plumps the skin a little.

I have had a lot of skin issues due to declining hormones in menopause. This product feels great on my skin and doesn't leave an oily residue. It does not clog pores or cause breakouts. Definitely recommend!

avis.titre: My skin is glowy when I u
avis.texte: My skin is glowy when I use it. Loving it so far, it is a lot more smaller than I thought though.
Very light weight yet great for this weather my face isn't dry and feels hydrated

Great oil for combination skin and those that are more acne prone. I have used this oil with a lightweight moisturizer every night for a few months and have definitely noticed an increased balance in oil production and texture.

avis.titre: The only serum that has genuinely worked for me
avis.texte: This is my second time buying the Bakuchiol oil from Good Molecules. I spent probably a solid two years trying to find a serum that could help me reduce my breakouts and oiliness without drying me out because I have very truly combination skin. Personally I like to keep my skin care very simple and this is the one item that has truly made a visible difference in my skin, I'm not even sugarcoating it. It works so well for me and I had a bottle last me six months. Truly I love this product and I'm grateful that I found something that works
I have not noticed any smell like other reviewers have noted. I use this on my neck and jawline for gua sha, and it's my favorite part of my skincare routine.

avis.titre: Whenever I use this oil I
avis.texte: Whenever I use this oil I get compliments about how my skin is glowing.
This oil has my skin glowing when I wake up and go to bed at night

I really love this oil. It simultaneously feels light and very hydrating. I put just 2 or so drops on every night in the spring/summer. When it starts getting colder and my skin gets more dry, I put on slightly more. It's an amazing product. I just wish they sold it in a bigger bottle!

I have oily acne prone skin. My acne is awful. However, im in my 30's and want to start using anti aging ingredients. This works great, definitely noticed less fine lines after a couple weeks use. I dont mind the smell and it doesnt make me breakout any more or less than anything else. I love this product, give it a try.

avis.titre: 💘Where have you been all my life???
avis.texte: My skin LOVVVES this magical little potion! Makes my face feel so soft and bouncy without irritating or clogging pores. So glad I found it!
My skin is sensitive, acne prone. This made my skin more oily and caused tons of breakouts. Not a fan.
I've only been using it for a little while but I can notice some small changes to the wrinkles by my eyes.

avis.titre: Sensitive, oily skin, product makes me breakout.
avis.texte: This product is very moisturizing and is okay to occasionally use. If i try to use it frequently, I breakout and my oily skin overproduces oil. I really wanted to love this but it doesnt work for my oily, sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Nourishing, but no results with fine lines
avis.texte: I've never been able to comfortably use an oil as a substitute for a moisturizer before this oil. It keeps my skin feeling soft and hydrated, and I often find myself slipping this oil into my gym bag as a travel-friendly, post-shower moisturizer. If I don't go overboard on application this oil is really good at moisturizing without looking oily. The downside is that I haven't seen many results in reducing my fine lines, and wrinkles though. I've been using it consistently twice a day for a month and still no changes. If buying specifically for loss of elasticity get ready to play the long game.
It irritates my skin with little bumps so I stopped using it after two weeks

I can't rave about Good Molecules enough. They have saved my skin! This oil is great for oily/acne prone skin. It minimizes your pores and takes care of excess oil. It leaves my skin soft and also helps texture.
I love that this product doesn't cause acne. Also, helps keep my skin moist at night. When I wake up I have a nice glow to my skin.
This is a logbtweight non greasy oil and its done wonders for my face.
I was a little hesitant on this simply because my skin is typically oily. However, if used as stated it's not heavy and doesn't feel thick on my face.

I was very nervous when I first bought this because I have combination skin. I get oily on my nose, but dry on my chin area & this moisturizer keeps my whole face balanced without getting oily or dry. I use two drops in the morning after toner & it lasts all day.

I had been using a regular retinol which was okay but I was over the 'burn' of redness the next day. Also, I would get a random deep cystic pimple and that's not okay. I have an oily t-zone and combination and sensitive skin and I was hesitant to try an oil, but I knew Bakuchiol would be more gentle. I use it 5-6 nights per week cycled with 1-2 nights of glycolic toner. This seems to be the magic combo! Six weeks in and I haven't had a single cystic pimple. My t-zone is majorly less oily and I've gone from multiple powder touch-ups during the day to one or two, max, which results in better looking makeup all day. My skin is less textured and more even toned and a little glowy, which is something I previously avoided with oilier skin. As for the review regarding smell, which dissipates quickly, it's not bad. I'd rather it doesn't smell like chemicals or fragrance. The price point is excellent and its clean and cruelty-free. I hope this never goes away cause I love it!!!!

I have very dry skin on my forehead, in between my eye brows and on the sides of my nostrils. This oil mixed with Good Molecules moisturizing lotion makes my skin hydrated!! Also makes me face have a glow to it. I love this Oil Blend, that advertises for oily skin. I have dry skin! It's perfect for me!
I use it everyday as a retinol alternative and it works nicely for my sensitive, oily skin! Saw results pretty quickly too. Would recommend!
First try at good molecules because a friend had recommended it so highly! Unfortunately, this didn't absorb into my skin and just left my face oily.
This product has revived my skins glow without making it become oily.

I have very oily skin, using this during the day was a horrible decision. the oil broke through before I even left the house. I tried using it at night & woke up with an oily face & didn't get much better even after washing.

avis.titre: Amazing for oily, acne prone skin!
avis.texte: I have extremely oily skin that is very acne prone and I absolutely love this product. I only use one drop in the morning as the last step of my routine after my oil free moisturizer. My skin has actually been less oily, more clear, and has a healthy looking glow to it. I was so scared to try a face oil since any products with oils in it has always made me break out terribly in the past but since this product is formulated for oily skin I figured I would give it a shot and I'm so glad I did.

I have very sensitive acne prone dry skin and this has been absolutely amazing. You will purge at first so start slowly, but now I am a couple of months in and use it daily and it keeps my skin so hydrated and really helps with my acne!

I have oily skin & I was really hoping this would work because other products I've gotten from here have been wonderful. Sadly it made me breakout after using it a couple days & the breakout only went away when I stopped using it.

Love that this is a retinol alternative because now I can use something for the daytime. But this helps control my oil so much! There's no oil slick. How does it just suck up all the oil on my face? I don't know but this is life!

I had high hopes for this oil considering it's for oily skin. However, it makes my skin break out like crazy. I've been using it for a month or so now and I only use 1 drop for my face but I still am breaking out form it.

I like it so far. I found that if I mix 2-3 drops in with my moisturizer, it works 10x better and doesn't leave a greasy film on my face. I only use it at night. After the first night, my skin was sooo soft and plump, and I had a huuuuge pimple that was almost gone the next morning. I had smaller bumps on my forehead that disappeared as well. After the second night, my pimple disappeared and I noticed a big difference in my skin texture. I skipped the third day and used it for the fourth. My makeup has applied more smoothly since I've started using it too. I like it so far, but I have to use it longer to see how it performs in the long run.

avis.titre: Bakuchiol oil blend, great alternative for retinol beginners
avis.texte: I really liked the bakuchiol oil blend, my skin doesn't feel greasy and it's a very good alternative if you are a retinol beginner, like I am. I do have blackheads in my cheeks, but when I put the oil in my cheeks I get a lot more, so since I like the product a lot I just avoid using it in that part of my face (I'm aware that it can be purging, that's why I don't mind it a lot). I also love to use it in my neck and chest. I've been using ir for about two or three weeks, I hope to see results in the next couple of months.

I was super excited to try this based on the reviews, but am floored. It smells like something old, rancid and dead. Does nobody else notice this? This will go straight in the trash. Total disappointment.

I needed an alternative to retinol and decided to try this. Okay, so it did definitely make my skin purge, but that means it's working. One month in, the breakouts have mostly gone away and my skin is hydrated and glowy! I use a hydrating toner with it at night and no moisturizer. It is going to feel greasy because it is oil-based, but I really like the oils used. I take a break from it 1-2 times a week when I use exfoliants and it's been great!
This oil is very emollient, soothing, and goes on thick without being overly oily and comedogenic feeling.

Excellent stuff!!! Great retinol alternative. Only been using less than a week with remarkable improvement on my skin texture. Firmer and bouncy as in my 20s. The good molecule is great. Thanks ulta for making available!!!

avis.titre: Bakuchiol oil blend for oily skin
avis.texte: I hate the size of the bottle it also left the temperature of my skin looking rough I don't like the feeling of it but other than I actually like products for from this brand
I love mixing this with my cerave moisturizing cream. It makes my face really soft and glowy. It's a magic potion and mixes well with other good molecules products. 10/10!

I decided to give this a try since my skin doesn't love retinol. I'm in my late 30s and have combo/oily/acne prone skin. The first night I put this on top of my moisturizer which I didn't love. It definitely felt like oil on my face. The next night I put a slab of moisturizer in my palm and did 3 drops of oil on top, then rubbed my palms together and used it that way. To me, that's the way to go! It didn't feel heavy at all and gave my skin a nice glow. I even do this in the morning now but instead of 3 drops I do 2 so it's lighter for the day. I use the Elf Happy Hydration moisturizer and it's a perfect day/night combo

avis.titre: Maybe oils just aren't for me? Also, more products in glass/
avis.texte: To be honest the only reason I tried this product was because I'm looking for a reasonably priced moisturizer that doesn't come in plastic. This however was not for me. It did sink in more than most oils, but it eft my oily-leaning skin feeling quite more oily, warm, and faintly drippy. I don't like feeling any kind of barrier on my face, so oils may not be for me. More importantly, please offer more moisturizer options in sustainable packaging!

Love this stuff. I add a couple of drops to my moisturizer for a bit of extra hydration. I do have oily skin and haven't had success with other oils. This one doesn't turn my face into an oil slick. :)

avis.auteur: Best facial oil for oily skin!
avis.texte: I surprised how small this bottle is but it actually is a good size to give this a real try without spending too much or wasting product if one didn't like. I have tried several bakuchiol oil but this one stands out to me just because the minimal ingredient list. I didn't break out, it didn't make me oily and I use it twice a day. It's becoming a Holy grail staple in my skincare. I got an extra bottle for my sisters stocking stuffer this year, among other things.
I was pleasantly surprised how hydrating and light this oil is. It smells amazing as well. So far I feel it has helped my skin. I will continue to use it so see more results.

I added this oil to my nighttime skincare regimen along with the discoloration correcting serum. It's the last step after I apply my moisturizer. I just press 2 drops into my skin and it absorbs pretty well. I'm giving 4 stars because I've only been using for about 2 weeks and I try to wait at least 3 months to discern a noticeable difference in skin improvement.

I have extremely oily skin and I use it almost every night . My skin used to be an oil well every morning and now I can hardly see any . My skin has got softer and smoother too ! I'm definitely buying it again .

I have extremely oily skin and I use it almost every night . My skin used to be an oil well every morning and now I can hardly see any . My skin has got softer and smoother too ! I'm definitely buying it again .
My skin is more firm and supple after using this. I also don't have the excessive oiliness during the day. I would highly recommend this.

I have only used this bakuchiol oil blend a few times (at night only), but when I wake up the next morning, my skin feels supple and soft. I don't have too many problems with my skin but I was still kind of struggling to get the glass skin look. Using the bakuchiol oil blend as my last step in my night routine finally gave me that beautiful glow!
I sent this product back. Too oily! I'm trying to control my oily skin. This added to my problem!

avis.titre: great glow for oily, sensitive skin
avis.texte: my skin situation: i'm 38 with lines making themselves quite comfortable across my forehead and slightly coming in around my marionette area. i'm white with some sun spots and increased freckling. my skin is oily with noticeable but not large pores, and i am prone to occasional break outs- well, i used to be. i only use this product at night, as it definitely does leave my skin a little shinier than i want during the day. that being said, since starting to use it nightly, my skin is so much smoother, brighter, plumper, and more hydrated. i feel like a new person! i use it second to last no matter what other treatment i am doing, and i put a thick moisturizer over it. my skin was looking tired and dull, and now i don't even bother with make up.

Was nervous about the oil for my skin but trusted the advertising that it was meant for oily skin and I do feel it brightens and moisturizes throughout the day and feels really nice! I only use three drops and press into my face with my fingertips!
I have been using this product for four months after my night routine. My skin is so smooth and firm for a woman my age, specially around my eyes. It is the perfect companion for my skin.

I was really happy with this product . Scared to purchased this product or any kind of serum due to sensitive skin ,but this product is awesome. I have sensitive oily skin ,It's a complicated combination Kind of skin . I will continuously purchase this product. 💕
